boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented Haverford rituals spanning arrival, self-governance, spring, major declaration, campus events, and graduation.

cards.title: Start with Customs
cards.subtitle: Haverford’s first-year transition tradition
cards.notes: Incoming students complete Customs Week and continue with a yearlong program; use its resources and Customs-group support to orient yourself.
cards.short_summary: Haverford describes Customs as arguably its oldest tradition, now centered on first-year support and community learning.
cards.evidence_claim: Haverford says Customs is arguably its oldest tradition and that its modern form supports students transitioning to college.
cards.access_notes: For incoming Haverford students; the College describes Customs as its new-student experience.

cards.title: Spot Pinwheel Day
cards.subtitle: Founders Green spring tradition
cards.notes: When colorful pinwheels appear on Founders Green, pause to see the campus-wide spring marker and photograph the display from public paths.
cards.short_summary: The College identifies Pinwheel Day as a Haverford tradition celebrated during spring.
cards.evidence_claim: President Wendy Raymond described Pinwheel Day as one of her favorite Haverford traditions in April 2026.
cards.source_title: Celebrating the Spring Semester | Haverford College
cards.access_notes: Seasonal outdoor display on campus; timing varies.

cards.title: Declare It Out Loud
cards.subtitle: VCAM major-declaration ceremony
cards.notes: Sophomores invited to the event can step to the microphone outside VCAM and announce a chosen major; follow Registrar instructions for formal filing.
cards.short_summary: The public declaration adds cowbells and a Registrar joke to the academic major-declaration milestone.
cards.evidence_claim: Haverford Magazine reports that sophomores have been invited each spring to announce their majors outside VCAM, a relatively new Haverford tradition.
cards.access_notes: Event participation is for Haverford sophomores; separately complete the Registrar’s formal declaration process.

cards.title: Catch Midnight Breakfast
cards.subtitle: Finals-week Haver-Tradition
cards.notes: Check student-event announcements during finals week for this breakfast gathering, where College leaders serve students breakfast fare.
cards.short_summary: Fords Against Boredom lists Midnight Breakfast among its Haver-Traditions, and the College places it in finals week.
cards.evidence_claim: Haverford’s campus-life page says Midnight Breakfast occurs during finals week and that deans and the President serve breakfast fare.
cards.access_notes: Campus event; confirm current event details with Fords Against Boredom or College announcements.

cards.title: Join BJs in Your PJs
cards.subtitle: Ben and Jerry’s Bingo Haver-Tradition
cards.notes: Look for a Fords Against Boredom event notice for BJs in your PJs, identified by the group as Ben and Jerry’s Bingo.
cards.short_summary: The student organization Fords Against Boredom explicitly names BJs in your PJs—Ben and Jerry’s Bingo—as a Haver-Tradition.
cards.evidence_claim: Haverford’s recognized-clubs page lists “BJs in your PJs (Ben and Jerry’s Bingo!)” among FAB’s Haver-Traditions.
cards.source_title: Recognized Clubs & Student Organizations | Haverford College
cards.access_notes: Campus event organized by Fords Against Boredom; check its current announcements for participation details.

cards.title: Watch for Watertag
cards.subtitle: Fords Against Boredom Haver-Tradition
cards.notes: Follow Fords Against Boredom’s current event notices for Watertag and take part only under the organizers’ posted rules and location guidance.
cards.short_summary: Watertag is one of the Haver-Traditions attributed to the student group Fords Against Boredom.
cards.evidence_claim: Haverford’s recognized-clubs page identifies Watertag as one of Fords Against Boredom’s Haver-Traditions.
cards.source_title: Recognized Clubs & Student Organizations | Haverford College
cards.access_notes: Campus event organized by Fords Against Boredom; follow current organizer guidance.

cards.title: Find a Screwdate Notice
cards.subtitle: Fords Against Boredom Haver-Tradition
cards.notes: Consult Fords Against Boredom’s current announcements for Screwdate details and participation expectations before deciding whether the event is for you.
cards.short_summary: Screwdate is explicitly listed by the College as one of FAB’s Haver-Traditions.
cards.evidence_claim: Haverford’s recognized-clubs page lists Screwdate among Fords Against Boredom’s Haver-Traditions.
cards.source_title: Recognized Clubs & Student Organizations | Haverford College
cards.access_notes: Campus event organized by Fords Against Boredom; details and participation are organizer-dependent.

cards.title: Take Part in Plenary
cards.subtitle: Biannual student self-governance meeting
cards.notes: Read the meeting materials before attending Plenary, then participate in the student body’s discussion and voting according to the published process.
cards.short_summary: Plenary is Haverford’s recurring forum for students to debate and shape campus policy.
cards.evidence_claim: Haverford describes Plenary as a long-standing self-governance tradition and identifies it as a biannual student body meeting.
cards.access_notes: Student-governance meeting; consult current Students’ Council or Honor Council materials for dates and procedures.

cards.title: Add Your Name in the Cupola
cards.subtitle: Pre-Commencement senior tradition
cards.notes: Eligible graduating seniors can follow College directions for the pre-Commencement cupola visit and add a name to its longstanding autograph collection.
cards.short_summary: Graduating seniors mark their departure by signing the Founders Hall cupola.
cards.evidence_claim: The College calls adding names to the Founders Hall cupola’s autograph collection a long-running tradition.
cards.source_title: Ready to Bloom: Commencement 2026 | Haverford College
cards.access_notes: For graduating seniors in the days before Commencement; access is arranged through College programming.

cards.title: Ring In Your Arrival
cards.subtitle: Convocation bell beside Founders Hall
cards.notes: After Convocation, first-year students ring the ground-level brass bell beside Founders Hall to mark their arrival in the Haverford community.
cards.short_summary: The new brass bell creates an arrival ritual and an accessible alternative for seniors marking departure.
cards.evidence_claim: Haverford states that first-year students will ring the new ground-level bell after Convocation to mark their arrival.
cards.source_title: Ringing in a New Tradition | Haverford College
cards.access_notes: Located at the flagstone circle adjacent to Founders Hall; the arrival ringing follows Convocation.
